name: SKYWAYS AIR SERVICES LTD
summary: Skyways Air Services Limited operates as a logistics and freight forwarding service provider. The company offers freight forwarding, trucking, warehousing, customs brokerage, technology driven express cargo, and parcel delivery, as well as value-added services domestic and international markets. It also provides live animal transport and dangerous goods logistics services. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
